newsitem.title: JAPAN: Pioneer Elec 96/97 earnings swing to profit - paper.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer Elec 96/97 earnings swing to profit - paper.

text.p: Pioneer Electronic Corp is expected to have posted a parent current profit of 1.5 billion yen in the year ended on March 31, compared with a loss of about 14.8 billion yen in the previous year, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun business daily said on Wednesday.
The improvement in Pioneer's business performance was mainly due to robust sales of its car audio equipment in overseas markets and the weak yen.
The company is also expected to have posted a net profit of about 2.5 billion yen in 1996/97, compared with a net loss of about 10 billion yen in 1995/96, the paper said.
In the current business year to March 1998, the company's parent current profit may rise further to around 15 billion yen, due to continuing strong overseas sales, the paper said.
A spokesman for the company was not immediately available for comment on the report.
